title: Fairness of Deep Ensembles: On the interplay between per-group task difficulty and under-representation
reasoning: The paper investigates algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation in deep learning ensembles for classification tasks. It focuses on the technical interplay between task difficulty and under-representation. While it briefly mentions bioethical principles (non-maleficence) as motivation for fairness, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the study.
